body:
Northwind Packaging Co.
4410 Industrial Pkwy
Tacoma, WA 98421

April 15, 2026

Dear Northwind Packaging,

We are writing regarding tariff surcharges billed on invoices NWP-202504-010, NWP-202505-011, NWP-202506-012, NWP-202507-013, NWP-202508-014, NWP-202509-015, NWP-202510-016, NWP-202511-017, NWP-202512-018, NWP-202601-019, and NWP-202602-020, covering the period from February 4, 2025, through February 20, 2026.

Could you please confirm whether you were the importer of record for these shipments?

Our contract includes the following provision in Clause 7:

"Supplier may add a tariff surcharge to invoices to recover customs duties actually paid by Supplier on Products sold to Buyer. Any such surcharge shall be stated as a separate line item and shall not exceed the duty actually incurred. If any duty underlying a surcharge is subsequently refunded, remitted, reduced or otherwise recovered by Supplier, whether by administrative action, protest, litigation or otherwise, Supplier shall credit Buyer the corresponding surcharge amounts within sixty (60) days of Supplier's receipt of such refund. Credits shall be issued as vendor credits applied against Buyer's open or future invoices, or at Buyer's election, by payment."

We have already received credit memo NWP-CM-202603-001 on March 6, 2026, for $500.00, which we appreciate.

If you have received a refund for these duties, we would appreciate a credit for our share. We are requesting a vendor credit of $4,106.40.

Accounts Payable, Sunbird Cafe Group

Harbor & Pine Coffee Equipment
212 Pier Street, Suite 4
Oakland, CA 94607

February 4, 2025

Dear Harbor & Pine Coffee Equipment,

We are writing regarding invoices HPC-202505-006, HPC-202507-007, HPC-202509-008, HPC-202511-009, and HPC-202601-010, covering the period from February 4, 2025 through February 20, 2026.

Could you please confirm whether you were the importer of record for the products on these invoices?

Our contract contains the following provision in clause 6: "Prices for imported Products are inclusive of customs duties, tariffs and similar import charges borne by Supplier. Supplier shall give Buyer thirty (30) days notice of any price change attributable to a change in such charges. In the event any duty, tariff or similar charge paid by Supplier with respect to Products sold to Buyer is refunded to Supplier by any governmental authority, Supplier shall pass through to Buyer a pro rata share of such refund attributable to Products purchased by Buyer during the period the charge was in effect, net of Supplier's reasonable documented costs of recovery, within ninety (90) days of receipt."

If you have received a refund for these duties from any governmental authority, we would appreciate a credit for our share. Based on our records, we believe a vendor credit of $3,665.16 would be appropriate.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Accounts Payable, Sunbird Cafe Group

9000 Mesa Verde Rd, Bldg C
Chandler, AZ 85226

February 4, 2025

Sincerely,
